title: Pure Telegram outcome renderer
requirements: Add a pure deterministic renderer accepting only exact TelegramConversationOutcome with exact ConversationResult. Define safe typed TelegramRenderError(code), immutable TelegramButton, TelegramMessage and TelegramRenderedOutcome (or equally exact names); tuples for collections. Preserve callback_query_id only as a separate outcome field for future answerCallbackQuery and never render it.

Support only OPEN/SELECT_SERVICE, HELP/HELP, SAVED/REQUESTER, RESET/START and ACCEPTED_UNCONFIRMED/ACCEPTED_UNCONFIRMED with semantic_code INQUIRY_ACCEPTED_UNCONFIRMED. Validate every exact kind/screen/data shape before output; do not call result.as_dict or expose adapter metadata, receipt/inquiry ids, draft/version, platform/sender/chat/event, service ids or raw internal values. DETAILS, REVIEW and all other combinations return UNSUPPORTED_SCREEN.

For SELECT_SERVICE read only the public catalog projection. Validate catalog_version 1..2147483647, services/options, normalized titles, active marker, duration, pricing_mode FIXED_PER_PERSON or NEGOTIATED, integer price minor units and currency. Flatten active options in source service/option order with inactive options excluded and stable zero-based ordinals. Render Russian service title, duration and price; fixed RUB integer minor units as human price with explicit 'за человека', negotiated as 'По договорённости'. Callback data is exactly v1:s:<catalog_version>:<active ordinal>; add rules/contacts button v1:h. Never expose raw ids. If unsafe, return CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE or MESSAGE_TOO_LONG without partial output.

Render HELP using only provided contact_info, location_link and visit_rules with Russian labels and v1:o; do not invent missing values. Render REQUESTER with 'Как к вам обращаться? Напишите имя одним сообщением.' and only permitted v1:h/v1:r actions. Render RESET with draft-cleared notice and v1:o. Render accepted-unconfirmed with explicit owner handoff and unconfirmed time/admission/payment, plus v1:o; trusted ids and replay metadata must never appear.

Enforce message length 1..4096 Unicode characters, button label deterministic reasonable bounds, callback_data ASCII/UTF-8 1..64 bytes and accepted v1 grammar. DTOs and errors have stable safe str/repr, renderer does not mutate or retain input, read env, log, use time/random, call HTTP/SDK/persistence or serialize transport.

Add exhaustive synthetic PublicCatalogRuntime-shaped tests for fixed/negotiated current horse services, prices/durations, active ordinals/callback bounds, malformed/duplicate/empty catalogs and every wrong type/bool/range/currency/pricing/duration/price/title shape; text/button limits; HELP optional fields; REQUESTER/RESET; accepted privacy; callback preservation; immutable DTOs, non-mutation, unsupported screens, safe errors and zero side effects. Export only from __init__.py. Copy this exact contract from primary .pipeline/TG-012-spec.json to tasks/specs/TG-012.json.
acceptance: Focused renderer tests, all Telegram suites in one pytest invocation, complete pytest, scope review and git diff --check pass.
Actual diff stays within the approved renderer, exports, tests and task spec paths; no API, conversation, resolver, transport, persistence, config, docs or SDK behavior changes.

shared_paths_approval.reason: Add the pure transport-neutral renderer over the reviewed Telegram outcome contract.
